timing: Added after source review and before generation of new BLEND results; the original input freeze is retained unchanged.
hypothesis: Switching the exact source asset from MASK to neighboring BLEND material can cause a rendered discontinuity even with identical geometry and PNG bytes.

controls.source_exact: Keep the original MASK GLB and PNG bytes unchanged at the research source label.
controls.source_material_only: Render the same original geometry and original PNG with experimental BLEND material; record the difference from the unchanged original MASK asset.
controls.source_neighborhood: Measure before to exact, exact to after, and before to after independently. The two BLEND sides alone cannot establish continuity at the MASK source point.
controls.mask_baseline: Compare an interval's identical interpolated PNGs using MASK and BLEND; the geometry, UV and camera remain fixed.
controls.fixed_view: Disable grid and auto-rotation, use fixed viewport/front camera and explicit rendered frames; report tone-mapped sRGB image changes separately from linear atlas changes.

limitations: A single 0.001-year epsilon is a local step diagnostic, not a convergence proof or visual-quality acceptance threshold.
Bilinear texture filtering creates fractional fragment alpha even from a binary-alpha PNG.
BLEND defaults to disabled depth writing in the installed loader; triangle ordering can change self-overlap appearance.
A canvas export may quantize partially transparent RGB; record alpha and black/white composite error separately.
If a source-point material transition fails, preserve that finding instead of declaring the entire display chain continuous.
